item.title: Superyacht industry nominations open for The Honours 2026
item.description: The Superyacht Life Foundation has opened nominations for the 2026 edition of The Honours, its annual programme recognising individuals making a meaningful impact within and beyond the superyachting world.

item.title: Fontvielle’s Avenue des Papalins to get a green makeover
item.description: A landscaping project is under way on Avenue des Papalins in Fontvieille, aimed at transforming a key pedestrian route in the district and improving the quality of life of residents and pedestrians.

item.title: Monaco rugby claims Winter Sevens title in Blagnac
item.description: Monaco's national rugby sevens team has won the Winter Sevens tournament in Blagnac, defeating Catalan side Seven Gats 12-0 in the final to claim the title for the first time in four attempts.

item.title: Monaco warns of threat to international order at UN Human Rights Council
item.description: Monaco is not a country that typically takes sides. But, at the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva on 23rd February, Isabelle Berro-Amadeï chose to speak bluntly about the state of the world.

item.title: Opéra de Monte-Carlo celebrates double win at the 2026 Oper! Awards
item.description: The Opéra de Monte-Carlo has taken two of the top prizes at the 2026 Oper! Awards, with Cecilia Bartoli named Best Production and Gianluca Capuano recognised as Best Conductor.

item.title: Drop everything – the world’s funniest wildlife photos are here and open for a public vote
item.description: These are the funniest wildlife photographs in the world — and voting for your favourite closes on 1st March. Here's why they matter far beyond the laughs.

item.title: It’s confirmed: Pope Leo XIV will make historic first papal visit to Monaco
item.description: A sitting pope has not visited Monaco in the modern era. That changes on 28th March, when Pope Leo XIV makes an Apostolic Visit to the Principality at the invitation of Prince Albert II.

item.title: MSR Jbonet: The firm behind Monaco’s most familiar places
item.description: Most people rarely notice the furniture around them - the reception counters at a hospital, the dividers in a school corridor, the seating in a conference hall. And yet these elements quietly shape our daily lives.

item.title: Key points from President Donald Trump’s record-long State of the Union address
item.description: It was a sprawling, combative speech that mixed economic self-congratulation with sharp attacks on Democrats, strong foreign policy rhetoric, and a series of symbolic moments that drew both standing ovations and vocal protests from the chamber floor.

item.title: The hottest June ever, a new all-time high and barely any winter — IMSEE’s 2025 weather report is out
item.description: The data published Wednesday by IMSEE confirms what most residents already suspected — 2025 was no ordinary year.
